title: Refactor god struct then add interface in Go — 3 turns
description: God struct does too much. Split it, keep tests green, then add interface and mock.

task_spec.prompt: Refactor `UserService` in `service/service.go`: extract the data storage operations into a separate concept while keeping the same public API. The existing `NewUserService()`, `CreateUser()`, `GetUser()`, `FormatUser()`, and `ListUsers()` must keep working. Run `go test ./...` to confirm no regressions.
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to confirm no regressions from your refactor. Also review the code you changed — is the separation clean? Look at any remaining duplication or unclear names.

Final pass: add a `UserStorer` interface with methods `CreateUser(name string) (int, error)`, `GetUser(id int) (string, bool)`, and `ListUsers() []string`. Make `UserService` implement it. Then run `go test ./...` and confirm everything is green — including the TestUserStore test that checks the interface.
success_criteria: UserService struct is refactored into clearer components
UserStorer interface defined with correct methods
